mapper.update: UPDATE nginx_minute_stat SET request_count = request_count + #{requestCount}, sum_request_time_ms = sum_request_time_ms + #{sumRequestTimeMs}, max_request_time_ms = CASE WHEN #{maxRequestTimeMs} > max_request_time_ms THEN #{maxRequestTimeMs} ELSE max_request_time_ms END, sum_upstream_time_ms = sum_upstream_time_ms + #{sumUpstreamTimeMs}, sum_upstream_connect_time_ms = sum_upstream_connect_time_ms + #{sumUpstreamConnectTimeMs}, sum_upstream_header_time_ms = sum_upstream_header_time_ms + #{sumUpstreamHeaderTimeMs}, sum_body_bytes = sum_body_bytes + #{sumBodyBytes}, status_2xx = status_2xx + #{status2xx}, status_4xx = status_4xx + #{status4xx}, status_5xx = status_5xx + #{status5xx}, upstream_5xx = upstream_5xx + #{upstream5xx}, cache_hit_count = cache_hit_count + #{cacheHitCount}, cache_miss_count = cache_miss_count + #{cacheMissCount}, https_count = https_count + #{httpsCount}, slow_count = slow_count + #{slowCount} WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND bucket_time = #{bucketTime} AND client_ip = #{clientIp} AND uri = #{uri} AND method = #{method}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nginx_minute_stat ( source_id, bucket_time, client_ip, uri, method, request_count, sum_request_time_ms, max_request_time_ms, sum_upstream_time_ms, sum_upstream_connect_time_ms, sum_upstream_header_time_ms, sum_body_bytes, status_2xx, status_4xx, status_5xx, upstream_5xx, cache_hit_count, cache_miss_count, https_count, slow_count, create_time ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{bucketTime}, #{clientIp}, #{uri}, #{method}, #{requestCount}, #{sumRequestTimeMs}, #{maxRequestTimeMs}, #{sumUpstreamTimeMs}, #{sumUpstreamConnectTimeMs}, #{sumUpstreamHeaderTimeMs}, #{sumBodyBytes}, #{status2xx}, #{status4xx}, #{status5xx}, #{upstream5xx}, #{cacheHitCount}, #{cacheMissCount}, #{httpsCount}, #{slowCount}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select:
SELECT uri AS "uri", SUM(slow_count) AS "slowCount", SUM(request_count) AS "requestCount", MAX(max_request_time_ms) AS "maxRequestTimeMs", ROUND(SUM(sum_request_time_ms) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0), 2) AS "avgRequestTimeMs" FROM nginx_minute_stat WHERE bucket_time >= #{startTime} AND bucket_time < #{endTime} AND source_id IN #{sid} AND slow_count > 0
GROUP BY uri ORDER BY SUM(slow_count) DESC, MAX(max_request_time_ms) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT bucket_time AS "bucketTime", SUM(request_count) AS "requestCount", SUM(status_4xx) AS "status4xx", SUM(status_5xx) AS "status5xx", ROUND(SUM(sum_request_time_ms) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0), 2) AS "avgRequestTimeMs", MAX(max_request_time_ms) AS "maxRequestTimeMs" FROM nginx_minute_stat WHERE bucket_time >= #{startTime} AND bucket_time < #{endTime} AND source_id IN #{sid}
GROUP BY bucket_time ORDER BY bucket_time ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(request_count), 0) AS "totalRequests", COALESCE(SUM(status_4xx), 0) AS "status4xx", COALESCE(SUM(status_5xx), 0) AS "status5xx", COALESCE(SUM(slow_count), 0) AS "slowCount", COALESCE(SUM(sum_request_time_ms), 0) AS "sumRequestTimeMs", COALESCE(MAX(max_request_time_ms), 0) AS "maxRequestTimeMs", COALESCE(SUM(sum_upstream_time_ms), 0) AS "sumUpstreamTimeMs", COALESCE(SUM(sum_upstream_connect_time_ms), 0) AS "sumUpstreamConnectTimeMs", COALESCE(SUM(sum_upstream_header_time_ms), 0) AS "sumUpstreamHeaderTimeMs", COALESCE(SUM(sum_body_bytes), 0) AS "sumBodyBytes", COALESCE(SUM(upstream_5xx), 0) AS "upstream5xx", COALESCE(SUM(cache_hit_count), 0) AS "cacheHit", COALESCE(SUM(cache_miss_count), 0) AS "cacheMiss", COALESCE(SUM(https_count), 0) AS "httpsCount" FROM nginx_minute_stat WHERE bucket_time >= #{startTime} AND bucket_time < #{endTime} AND source_id IN #{sid}
